movie_title: Where do your tips go? - 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes! 
Sam and Neil talk about tipping

vocabulary.definition: something that is a choice for the person doing it and is not an obligation
vocabulary.example: Tipping in this restaurant is discretionary, so you can decide whether to leave a tip or not.

vocabulary.definition: acting or behaving in the same way over and over again
vocabulary.example: She is known for her consistent performance in every match.
Wearing a seatbelt in the car is mandatory for safety reasons.
The new regulations were imposed on the employees without any discussion.

vocabulary.definition: referring to card or digital payments, rather than notes and coins
vocabulary.example: Many stores nowadays prefer cashless transactions for faster and more convenient payments.

vocabulary.definition: to group together all in one place
vocabulary.example: The tips collected from customers are pooled and then distributed among the restaurant staff.
